name: Chrono Pendulum "Plague"
descriptionTemplate: At battle start, shuffle 3 random Symptom Cards into your deck. At turn start, draw 1 card. Playing each Symptom Card grants 2 Arithmetica. Discarding each Symptom Card grants all Awakeners 5 Aliemus, up to 5 times per turn.
